visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large circular platter filled with assorted sushi rolls and nigiri is shown. A hand uses chopsticks to lift a piece of grilled eel sushi. The setting is a restaurant with warm indoor lighting. (2) Consecutive close-ups highlight different sushi types: shrimp nigiri, inari (tofu skin) sushi, and maki rolls with various fillings like cucumber and crab. (3) The focus shifts to raw fish options, showing salmon and tuna nigiri with glossy textures. A small bowl of sashimi is visible in the background. (4) Special items are presented, including a piece of sushi topped with crab meat and a small flag, a sea urchin and scallop combination wrapped in seaweed, and a crab paste hand roll in a holder. (5) A seafood bowl (chirashi don) with salmon, tuna, roe, and tamagoyaki is displayed. This is followed by a shot of a braised salmon head in a dark ceramic bowl garnished with green onions. (6) Sweet treats are introduced: a skewer of three-colored dango, a cup of creamy panna cotta with berry sauce, and a chocolate sundae with marshmallows in a cone. (7) Three bottles of Japanese soft drinks, including Ramune, are lined up. The background shows more restaurant seating. (8) The camera pans across the restaurant interior, which features walls densely covered in colorful posters and Japanese-style lanterns. (9) A Corgi dog with a bandana around its neck is shown sitting calmly on the floor. (10) Staff members in black uniforms and masks are seen bowing behind the sushi bar. The final shots show the exterior of the shop with a large yellow wooden sign.
